teamUi.title: Team
teamUi.subtitleRead: The people in your clinic and the roles they hold. To add staff or change roles, contact AltCare.
teamUi.noAccess: You do not have access to the team page.
teamUi.loadFailed: Could not load this. Please try again.
teamUi.failed: Could not save the change. Please try again.

members.intro: Everyone who can sign in to your clinic. Each person's access is the combination of their roles. To add someone or change their access, contact AltCare.

invite.title: Add a staff member
invite.description: They get an email with a link to set their own password. You choose what they can do.

memberRoles.title: Roles for {name}
memberRoles.description: Their access is everything the ticked roles allow, together. Changes apply at once.

roles.intro: A role is a set of things a person is allowed to do. Built-in roles cannot be changed. To get a new role or change one, contact AltCare.
roles.deleteBlocked: People still hold this role. Change their roles first.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role {name}? This cannot be undone.
roles.cannotAssign: You cannot give this role: it allows things you cannot do yourself.

editor.description: Name the role and tick what it allows.
editor.copyOf: Starting from {name}. Change what you need.
editor.youDoNotHold: You do not have this permission yourself, so you cannot give it.
editor.acknowledge: {count, plural, =1 {# ticked permission is sensitive.} other {# ticked permissions are sensitive.}} I understand and want to give it to this role.

activity.intro: Every change AltCare made to roles and access in your clinic, newest first.

platform.title: Platform team
platform.subtitleManage: Add platform staff and decide what each person can do across AltCare. Changes take effect straight away.
platform.subtitleRead: The platform staff and the roles they hold.
platform.noAccess: You do not have access to the platform team page.
platform.membersIntro: Everyone on the AltCare platform team. Each person's access is the combination of their roles.
platform.rolesIntro: A role is a set of things platform staff are allowed to do. Admin and Operator are built in and cannot be changed; copy one to make a role such as Support or Finance.
platform.inviteDescription: They get an email with a link to set their own password. You choose what they can do on the platform.
platform.activityIntro: Every change to roles and access, on the platform and inside clinics, newest first.

byPlatform.subtitleManage: Add this clinic's staff and decide what each person can do. The clinic cannot change this itself; it contacts AltCare.
byPlatform.subtitleRead: This clinic's staff and the roles they hold.
byPlatform.membersIntro: Everyone who can sign in to this clinic. Each person's access is the combination of their roles.
byPlatform.rolesIntro: A role is a set of things a person is allowed to do. Built-in roles cannot be changed; copy one, or build a role from scratch, for this clinic.
byPlatform.activityIntro: Every change to roles and access in this clinic, newest first.
